games.title: Knack
games.summary: Gather ancient relics and grow into a towering hero.
about: Knack can absorb relics to change his size and combat abilities. Travel through cities, forests and caves, battle a goblin army and uncover the secrets behind the ancient fragments. A second player can join locally as Robo Knack.

games.title: Call of Duty: Ghosts
games.summary: Fight alongside the Ghosts in a world turned upside down.
about: Join a specialist squad in a military campaign set after a devastating attack has changed the global balance of power. Move through intense combat encounters and use your team’s abilities to confront a technologically superior enemy.

games.title: Watch Dogs™
games.summary: Turn Chicago’s connected infrastructure into a tool for investigation and action.
about: Play Aiden Pearce as he follows the people responsible for a family tragedy. Use hacking to access cameras, disrupt traffic and manipulate city systems while exploring the open world and tackling missions. Optional expansions and other paid content are not individually verified.

games.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes
games.summary: Bring Marvel heroes together for a brick-built adventure.
about: Join Iron Man, Spider-Man, the Hulk and other Marvel characters in an original story about stopping Loki and his allies. Explore LEGO environments, use each hero’s abilities and break apart obstacles along the way.

games.title: Battlefield 4
games.summary: Follow a squad through a military crisis that starts in Shanghai.
about: Take part in a modern combat campaign built around a squad struggling to reach safety. Use weapons and vehicles across changing battlefields where destructive environments create new tactical possibilities.

games.title: The Order: 1886
games.summary: Enter a darker Victorian London as a knight of the Order.
about: Take the role of Galahad in a reimagined London where an ancient order uses advanced weapons against human rebels and supernatural threats. A cinematic campaign blends third-person combat with investigation as loyalties and long-held beliefs begin to unravel.

games.title: Flower
games.summary: Carry petals through landscapes on a gentle current of wind.
about: Guide the wind through open fields and changing landscapes, gathering flower petals as you travel. Simple movement and environmental interactions create a quiet journey through scenes that respond to your presence.

games.title: Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Survive Lara Croft’s first expedition.
about: Explore a hostile island as a young Lara Croft learns to survive its dangers. Gather equipment, improve weapons and overcome environmental obstacles in the PS4 Definitive Edition of the 2013 adventure.

games.title: Batman: Arkham Knight
games.summary: Protect Gotham in the final chapter of the Arkham trilogy.
about: Scarecrow threatens Gotham as Batman confronts the mysterious Arkham Knight. Glide above the city, investigate its streets and take the Batmobile into action, combining detective work with the series’ close combat and stealth encounters.

games.title: Need for Speed Rivals
games.summary: Choose a side in Redview County's cops-versus-racers rivalry.
about: Drive as a police officer or street racer through an open road network, taking on challenges and unlocking cars and pursuit equipment. The game's online servers have closed; offline play remains the relevant mode for this edition.

games.title: Worms™ Battlegrounds
games.summary: Lead a team of worms through physics-driven tactical battles.
about: Use an eccentric arsenal and destructible environments to outmaneuver opponents. A story campaign adds machinery, moving obstacles and rescue challenges alongside the familiar turn-based combat.

games.title: Trials Fusion™
games.summary: Master balance and momentum across elaborate motorcycle obstacle courses.
about: Ride through demanding platform-racing tracks where careful control matters as much as speed. Learn each course, recover from mistakes and refine your runs to reach the finish with fewer faults.

games.title: Wolfenstein: The New Order
games.summary: Fight an occupying regime in an alternate-history Europe.
about: Join a resistance movement as B.J. Blazkowicz in a 1960s world shaped by a different outcome to the Second World War. Combine heavy weapons and infiltration to confront soldiers, machines and the technology behind the regime’s power.

games.title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
games.summary: Follow Nathan Drake on a final search for pirate treasure.
about: Nathan Drake leaves retirement when a personal debt draws him into another treasure hunt. Explore remote ruins, climb dangerous terrain and fight through a globe-spanning adventure that puts his family and loyalties under strain.

games.title: Alien: Isolation
games.summary: Stay unseen while a relentless alien hunts through Sevastopol.
about: Amanda Ripley searches for answers about her mother’s disappearance aboard a deteriorating space station. With limited resources and few reliable defenses, survival depends on listening, hiding and improvising as hostile people, machines and an unpredictable creature close in.

games.title: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number
games.summary: Follow intersecting stories through a violent neon-soaked crime saga.
about: Switch between characters and factions whose actions echo the events of the original Hotline Miami. Plan rapid assaults through compact spaces and uncover how their conflicting motives feed an escalating cycle of violence.

games.title: FEZ
games.summary: Rotate your perspective to reveal a hidden world.
about: Travel with Gomez through a world that appears flat until a new dimension changes everything. Rotate the view to connect platforms, uncover routes and solve puzzles, exploring colourful spaces filled with symbols, secrets and unexpected connections.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V
games.summary: Three criminals share an increasingly dangerous life in Los Santos.
about: Switch between Franklin, Michael and Trevor as their overlapping lives lead to ambitious heists and escalating trouble. Explore Los Santos and the surrounding countryside, combining story missions with driving, diversions and the freedom to wander a large open world.

games.title: Valiant Hearts: The Great War™
games.summary: Follow ordinary people and their canine companion through the Great War.
about: Experience intertwining stories of friendship, loss and survival during the First World War. Explore illustrated battlefields and solve environmental puzzles while a faithful dog helps the characters find their way through the conflict.

games.title: Hotline Miami
games.summary: Survive fast, unforgiving encounters in a neon-soaked Miami.
about: Answer mysterious calls that send a masked protagonist into violent confrontations with Miami’s criminal underworld. Plan routes, improvise with weapons and restart quickly while a surreal story questions the motives behind each assignment.

games.title: Spelunky
games.summary: Descend into unpredictable caverns filled with danger and treasure.
about: Explore newly arranged levels on every run, using tools and careful movement to survive traps and creatures. Search for secrets on your own or bring friends into local cooperative and competitive play.

games.title: Beyond: Two Souls
games.summary: Guide two linked souls through one extraordinary life.
about: Follow Jodie Holmes, a young woman connected to the mysterious entity Aiden. Switch between their abilities, navigate tense encounters and make choices that shape an emotional supernatural story spanning different stages of Jodie’s life.

games.title: The Last of Us Remastered
games.summary: Two survivors cross a country transformed by infection.
about: Travel with Joel and Ellie through abandoned cities and hostile territory in a story about trust and survival. Combine stealth, combat and limited supplies while navigating dangers from infected creatures and other people.

games.title: inFAMOUS First Light
games.summary: Uncover Fetch’s past through a standalone superpowered adventure.
about: Follow Fetch as she relives the events that led to her imprisonment. Use neon abilities across Seattle and confront the people and memories behind her search for vengeance.

games.title: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham
games.summary: Take Batman’s brick-built adventure beyond Earth.
about: Team up with heroes and villains from the DC universe to stop Brainiac from shrinking entire worlds. Travel through the Lantern realms, use character abilities and tackle puzzles in a playful adventure across space.

games.title: Another World: 20th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Survive an alien world after a laboratory experiment goes wrong.
about: Physicist Lester is thrown into an unfamiliar land of strange creatures and hostile forces. This anniversary version of the cinematic adventure combines platforming, environmental puzzles and sudden danger with updated presentation and the option to revisit its original visuals.

games.title: Transistor
games.summary: Wield a mysterious weapon in a striking science-fiction city.
about: Guide Red through a futuristic world using the extraordinary Transistor. Combine abilities and tactical planning with action combat while uncovering the story behind the weapon and the city around her.

games.title: Journey
games.summary: Cross a silent desert toward a distant mountain.
about: Guide a robed traveler through dunes and ancient ruins, discovering ways to glide above the sand and reach new paths. Music, movement and visual storytelling carry a compact adventure through a mysterious civilization’s remains.

games.title: Terraria
games.summary: Dig, build and explore a world of your own.
about: Gather resources, craft equipment and shape a side-scrolling world as you explore above and below ground. Build a home, seek out treasure and prepare for creatures and bosses that challenge your progress.

games.title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
games.summary: Discover strange powers in a changing maze of dangerous rooms.
about: Guide Isaac through randomly generated environments, battling creatures and collecting items that transform each run. Experiment with combinations of abilities while uncovering secrets and trying to survive.

games.title: Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris
games.summary: Explore an Egyptian temple filled with puzzles and deadly traps.
about: Join Lara Croft and her companions in an isometric action adventure, combining combat, exploration and environmental puzzles. Work together in local cooperative play while competing for treasure. This base-game listing does not establish ownership of the separate season pass or DLC packs.

games.title: Nidhogg

games.title: Saints Row: Gat Out of Hell

games.title: Ratchet & Clank
games.summary: Blast into a reimagined galactic origin story.

games.title: Gravity Rush Remastered
games.summary: Turn the city upside down.
about: Guide Kat through the floating city of Hekseville as she learns to control gravity and pieces together her missing past. Explore streets, walls and open skies while confronting the strange forces threatening her home.

games.title: Street Fighter V: Champion Edition
games.summary: Read your opponent and build decisive fighting combinations.

games.title: Gone Home

games.title: Axiom Verge
games.summary: Explore an alien labyrinth with weapons that bend its rules.
about: A laboratory accident leaves a scientist stranded in a strange world of machines and organic ruins. Search interconnected areas for tools and abilities, battle their inhabitants, and exploit unusual glitches to open new routes and unravel what brought you there.

games.title: Zombie Army Trilogy
games.summary: Battle an undead army across three horror-shooter campaigns.

games.title: LIMBO
games.summary: Guide a lone boy through a haunting world of silhouettes.
about: Explore a stark black-and-white landscape where threatening creatures and dangerous mechanisms conceal the path forward. Solve environmental puzzles, observe each new hazard and learn from mistakes as a young boy searches for his missing sister.

games.title: Rocket League®
games.summary: Send the ball flying in fast matches of car-powered football.
about: Drive, jump and boost through a sporting arena where cars compete to score goals. Practise ball control and aerial moves, with local play and match options forming the core of the experience.

games.title: Wolfenstein: The Old Blood

games.title: PaRappa The Rapper 2™

games.title: Killzone Shadow Fall

games.title: inFAMOUS Second Son
games.summary: Discover what you will do with extraordinary power.

games.title: F1 2015
games.summary: Take your place on the Formula One grid.
about: Race the cars and circuits of the 2015 Formula One season, learning the demands of each track and chasing a championship. Refine your driving in the game’s solo season modes and work toward cleaner, faster laps.

games.title: Alienation™

games.title: LittleBigPlanet 3
games.summary: Bring Sackboy and his friends into a handmade adventure.

games.title: Rayman Legends
games.summary: Jump into colourful worlds filled with inventive platforming challenges.
about: Guide Rayman and his friends through illustrated stages packed with enemies, secrets and moving obstacles. Combine precise movement with playful level design, including sequences where actions follow the music.

games.title: Dying Light
games.summary: Cross an infected city using parkour, scavenged tools and improvised weapons.
about: Explore an open city devastated by a zombie outbreak. Climb rooftops, gather supplies and craft equipment to survive encounters with the infected, adapting your routes and tactics as daylight gives way to more dangerous nights.

games.title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition

games.title: DRIVECLUB
games.summary: Drive high-performance cars across scenic racing routes.

games.title: Angry Birds Star Wars
games.summary: Use bird powers and physics in a familiar galaxy.

games.title: The Evil Within

games.title: The Swapper
